title: More than one note
summary: Play a group of sounds together.

steps.title: More than one note
steps.body:
**chord** means two or more notes sounding together. Start with C, E and G. On the screen, tap one position for each note; it stays selected until tapped again. Escape clears all selected notes.

**Why it matters:** A chord gives a tune a supporting sound. You can learn the sound first, before a full shape.

steps.title: Read and hear the notes
steps.body: Try string 5 fret 3 (C), string 4 fret 2 (E), and open string 3 (G). Leave the other strings unselected. Tap these three positions so they sound together.

items.prompt: Play C, E, G together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Tap one note, then add another. Clear them with Escape before starting again. A microphone hears one note at a time, so use tap input for these chord checks.

items.prompt: Play C, E, G together. Use any positions for these notes.
